title: Surrogate-Guided Adaptive Importance Sampling for Failure Probability Estimation
summary: We consider the sample efficient estimation of failure probabilities from expensive oracle evaluations of a limit state function via importance sampling (IS). In contrast to conventional ``two stage'' approaches, which first train a surrogate model for the limit state and then construct an IS proposal to estimate failure probability using separate oracle evaluations, we propose a \emph{single stage} approach where a Gaussian process surrogate and a surrogate for the optimal (zero-variance) IS density are trained from shared evaluations of the oracle, making better use of a limited budget.…
